Package edu.bu.pas.risk.util

Class TrustlessRiskListener

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.risk.util.TrustlessRiskListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
RiskListener
public final class TrustlessRiskListener extends Object implements RiskListener
Wraps a RiskListener and makes it secure via:
  1. adding timeouts
  2. copying game state
  3. catching unhandled exceptions

Note that for small timeoutMillis (e.g. <50), we are the whims of the OS to accurately timeout tasks.

This implementation is also SLOW. We copy a new game state 1 agent. This is necessary, but leads to hundreds of copies per turn per agent.
